candidates.name: Kevin Hern
candidates.bio: U.S. Representative for Oklahoma’s 1st District since 2018 and a former McDonald’s franchise owner.

candidates.name: N’Kiyla Jasmine Thomas
candidates.bio: Nurse, active-duty military spouse and Chickasaw Nation citizen from Ardmore, running for office for the first time.
